newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU TO ISSUE 70 MLN DM IN BONDS.
newsitem.headline: HOIU TO ISSUE 70 MLN DM IN BONDS.

text.p: Hoiupank, Estonia's third largest bank, said on Wednesday that it will issue bonds worth 70 million DM in foreign markets.
Out of the total sum, Hoiupank will receive 20 million kroons as a seven-year subordinated loan, Heino Viik, the head of the bank's finance division, told Reuters.
The lead bank for the issue is Credit Suisse First Boston.
The rest of the issue has a term of three years, Viik added.
Viik said Credit Suisse has started marketing the issue in the market and the bank hopes to sign the agreement next week.
Viik earlier told Reuters that the bank needs to finance its growth and refinance some old loans.
